df['word_count'] = df['text'].apply(lambda x: len(str(x).split()))


df['unique_word_count'] = df['text'].apply(lambda x: len(set(str(x).split())))


df['stop_word_count'] = df['text'].apply(lambda x: len([w for w in str(x).lower().split() if w in STOPWORDS]))


df['url_count'] = df['text'].apply(lambda x: len([w for w in str(x).lower().split() if 'http' in w or 'https' in w]))


df['mean_word_length'] = df['text'].apply(lambda x: np.mean([len(w) for w in str(x).split()]))


df['char_count'] = df['text'].apply(lambda x: len(str(x)))


df['punctuation_count'] = df['text'].apply(lambda x: len([c for c in str(x) if c in string.punctuation]))


df['hashtag_count'] = df['text'].apply(lambda x: len([c for c in str(x) if c == '#']))


df['mention_count'] = df['text'].apply(lambda x: len([c for c in str(x) if c == '@']))

# --- [CELL 4]: ---


df['word_count'].loc[df['word_count']>60] = 60
df['char_count'].loc[df['char_count']>350] = 350
df['punctuation_count'].loc[df['punctuation_count']>10] = 10

f, axes = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(20,30))
sns.boxplot(x='target', y='word_count', data=df, ax=axes[0])
axes[0].set_xlabel('Target', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_title("Number of words in each class", fontsize=15)

sns.boxplot(x='target', y='char_count', data=df, ax=axes[1])
axes[1].set_xlabel('Target', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_title("Number of characters in each class", fontsize=15)

sns.boxplot(x='target', y='punctuation_count', data=df, ax=axes[2])

axes[2].set_title("Number of punctuations in each class", fontsize=15)

import tensorflow as tf
from transformers import BertConfig

# tf.keras.utils.plot_model expects a tf.keras.Model, while bert_model is a PyTorch model.
# Load the TensorFlow equivalent BERT model and plot that instead.
tf_bert_model = tf.keras.Model.from_config(BertConfig.from_pretrained('bert-base-uncased').to_dict())
tf.keras.utils.plot_model(tf_bert_model, show_shapes=True)

import tensorflow as tf
from transformers import TFBertModel

# Use the TensorFlow BERT model (compatible with tf.keras plotting utilities)
tf_bert_model = TFBertModel.from_pretrained('bert-base-uncased')
tf.keras.utils.plot_model(tf_bert_model, show_shapes=True)
